## Summary

Describe the skill or repository change and the problem it solves.

## Validation

- [ ] I ran `python scripts/validate_skills.py`.
- [ ] I ran `python -m unittest discover -s tests -v`.
- [ ] Skill names and descriptions follow the documented format.
- [ ] New or changed links and scripts were reviewed.

## Licensing and safety

- [ ] This contribution is original or compatible with the MIT License.
- [ ] Required attribution and source links are included.
- [ ] No credentials, private data, or machine-specific secrets are included.
- [ ] Destructive actions, network access, dependencies, and permissions are
      absent or clearly documented and justified.
